metadata.title: 5 Things to Know Before the Stock Market Opens on Wednesday

content.text:
Stock futures are pointing to a mixed open for major indexes, as investors await the Federal Reserve's decision on interest rates and earnings reports from major tech companies; the Fed is expected to hold its key rate steady today after hiking it last month for the first time in three years; Google parent Alphabet and Microsoft headline a busy earnings calendar today; Seagate shares are slipping despite a better-than-expected earnings report; and Robinhood stock is down after the trading platform's earnings came in short of Wall Street estimates. Here's what you need to know today.
Stock Futures Are Mixed as Fed Decision, Tech Earnings Loom
Stock futures are mixed this morning after two straight days of gains as the Fed's rate decision and a slew of earnings reports loom. Futures tracking the Dow Jones Industrial Average were down 0.2% in recent trading, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures rose 0.2% and 0.4%, respectively. The major indexes closed higher yesterday, extending a solid start to the week thanks to a tech rally sparked in part by AI giant Anthropic publicly filing its initial public offering documents. WTI crude oil futures were up 2%recently at $101.75 per barrel, while gold futures fell slightly to $4,060 an ounce, and bitcoin traded at $81,300, up from yesterday's low of $79,300. The yield on the 10-year Treasury, which affects interest rates on loans, ticked higher to 5.01%.
Fed Set to Announce Rate Decision This Afternoon
The Federal Open Market Committee is set to announce its decision on interest rates at 2:00 p.m. ET. The policy committee is widely expected to leave the Fed's benchmark rate unchanged despite persistent inflation, after raising it last month for the first time in three years. Keeping rates where they are could mean the Fed is prepared to wait out the inflation driven by the Iran war, but market watchers have also said that no movement today would make a hike at the next meeting in December almost certain. While traders are pricing in less than a 10% chance the central bank will raise its key rate today, the odds for a December increase are currently at 86%, according to CME Group's FedWatch Tool. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is scheduled to speak at a press conference half an hour after the rate decision is announced, and investors will be eager to hear what he says about the outlook for the economy as they look for clues about future rate moves.
Google, Microsoft Headline Busy Earnings Schedule
The AI trade has powered markets higher to open the week, and results from Alphabet (GOOGL) and Microsoft (MSFT), each due after tonight's closing bell, will help determine where tech stocks are headed next. Both companies are expected to report another quarter of solid revenue and profit growth, but investors will likely be keeping a close eye on one metric for both companies: cloud revenue. Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure will need to continue posting solid growth to show investors that there is enough AI demand to support the companies' massive fundraising and spending plans. Fellow Magnificent 7 member Amazon (AMZN), which also has a sizable cloud business, is due to report results tomorrow. Other companies set to release quarterly numbers later today include ServiceNow (NOW), T-Mobile (TMUS), FedEx (FDX), Ford (F) and Chipotle (CMG).
